title: Why Your Phone Doesn't Feel You: The Truth Behind Touchscreens
speaker: Talun
zh: 【Talun】為什麼你的手機感覺不到你：觸控螢幕背後的真相（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: You touched a screen to get here.
cues.en: You touched a screen to get here.
cues.zh: 您觸控了螢幕才到達這裡。

cues.text: You will touch one a few thousand times before the day is out, and you have never
cues.en: You will touch one a few thousand times before the day is out, and you have never
cues.zh: 在一天結束之前，你會觸控其中幾千次，但你從來沒有

cues.text: once wondered whether it can feel you.
cues.en: once wondered whether it can feel you.
cues.zh: 曾經想知道它是否能感覺到你。

cues.text: It can't.
cues.en: It can't.
cues.zh: 不可以。

cues.text: Not badly.
cues.en: Not badly.
cues.zh: 還不錯。

cues.text: Not approximately.
cues.en: Not approximately.
cues.zh: 大約不是。

cues.text: Your phone has no sense of touch at all, and the engineers who built it knew that,
cues.en: Your phone has no sense of touch at all, and the engineers who built it knew that,
cues.zh: 你的手機根本沒有觸覺，製造它的工程師知道，

cues.text: and chose it anyway.
cues.en: and chose it anyway.
cues.zh: 無論如何還是選擇了它。

cues.text: The proof arrives every winter.
cues.en: The proof arrives every winter.
cues.zh: 證據每年冬天都會來。

cues.text: You are outside, it is cold, you have gloves on, and the phone ignores
cues.en: You are outside, it is cold, you have gloves on, and the phone ignores
cues.zh: 你在外面，天氣很冷，你戴著手套，手機無視

cues.text: you.
cues.en: you.
cues.zh: 你。

cues.text: Not a mis-tap.
cues.en: Not a mis-tap.
cues.zh: 不是誤按。

cues.text: Not a slow response.
cues.en: Not a slow response.
cues.zh: 反應不慢。

cues.text: Nothing at all, as though the screen were switched off.
cues.en: Nothing at all, as though the screen were switched off.
cues.zh: 什麼都沒有，就像螢幕被關閉一樣。

cues.text: Take the glove off and it wakes up instantly.
cues.en: Take the glove off and it wakes up instantly.
cues.zh: 摘下手套，它立刻就醒了。

cues.text: So the screen can tell the difference between your finger and two millimetres of
cues.en: So the screen can tell the difference between your finger and two millimetres of
cues.zh: 所以螢幕可以分辨出你的手指和兩毫米的物體之間的區別

cues.text: wool.
cues.en: wool.
cues.zh: 羊毛。

cues.text: That sounds like a sensitive instrument.
cues.en: That sounds like a sensitive instrument.
cues.zh: 這聽起來像是一個敏感的樂器。

cues.text: It isn't.
cues.en: It isn't.
cues.zh: 事實並非如此。

cues.text: It never saw either one.
cues.en: It never saw either one.
cues.zh: 它從未見過其中任何一個。

cues.text: The first touchscreen was built in nineteen sixty-five, in Malvern, England, by a man named Eric Johnson at
cues.en: The first touchscreen was built in nineteen sixty-five, in Malvern, England, by a man named Eric Johnson at
cues.zh: 第一個觸控螢幕是由一位名叫 Eric Johnson 的人於 19 65 年在英國馬爾文製造的。

cues.text: the Royal Radar Establishment.
cues.en: the Royal Radar Establishment.
cues.zh: 皇家雷達機構。

cues.text: He published it that October in a journal called Electronics Letters, under a title with no drama in it
cues.en: He published it that October in a journal called Electronics Letters, under a title with no drama in it
cues.zh: 那年 10 月，他將這篇文章發表在一本名為《Electronics Letters》的期刊上，標題中沒有任何戲劇性的內容。

cues.text: whatsoever: Touch Display — A Novel Input Output Device for Computers.
cues.en: whatsoever: Touch Display — A Novel Input Output Device for Computers.
cues.zh: 不管怎樣：觸控顯示器－一種新型的電腦輸入輸出裝置。

cues.text: The US patent followed in sixty-nine.
cues.en: The US patent followed in sixty-nine.
cues.zh: 美國專利緊隨其後，排在六十九位。

cues.text: He was not building a toy.
cues.en: He was not building a toy.
cues.zh: 他不是在製造玩具。

cues.text: He was building it for air traffic control, where a man watching a radar screen needed to point at an aircraft
cues.en: He was building it for air traffic control, where a man watching a radar screen needed to point at an aircraft
cues.zh: 他正在為空中交通管制建造它，一個觀看雷達螢幕的人需要指向一架飛機

cues.text: faster than he could type its identifier.
cues.en: faster than he could type its identifier.
cues.zh: 比他輸入識別符號的速度還要快。

cues.text: And the thing he built was capacitive.
cues.en: And the thing he built was capacitive.
cues.zh: 他建造的東西是電容式的。

cues.text: Not a pressure pad.
cues.en: Not a pressure pad.
cues.zh: 不是壓力墊。

cues.text: Not a mechanical switch.
cues.en: Not a mechanical switch.
cues.zh: 不是機械開關。

cues.text: A grid of copper that watched an electric field.
cues.en: A grid of copper that watched an electric field.
cues.zh: 觀察電場的銅網格。

cues.text: That is what I find hard to let go of.
cues.en: That is what I find hard to let go of.
cues.zh: 這就是我難以割捨的。

cues.text: The technology in your pocket is the original idea, filed before the
cues.en: The technology in your pocket is the original idea, filed before the
cues.zh: 你口袋裡的技術是最初的想法，在

cues.text: microprocessor existed, set aside for forty years, and then brought back.
cues.en: microprocessor existed, set aside for forty years, and then brought back.
cues.zh: 微處理器已經存在，擱置了四十年，然後又被帶回來。

cues.text: What replaced it in the meantime is the whole story.
cues.en: What replaced it in the meantime is the whole story.
cues.zh: 同時，取代它的是整個故事。

cues.text: So go into the screen.
cues.en: So go into the screen.
cues.zh: 那就進入畫面吧。

cues.text: Under the glass there is a grid of transparent conductor, laid down in two
cues.en: Under the glass there is a grid of transparent conductor, laid down in two
cues.zh: 玻璃下面有一個透明導體網格，分成兩部分

cues.text: sets of lines.
cues.en: sets of lines.
cues.zh: 線組。

cues.text: Rows running one way, columns running the other, separated by a thin insulating
cues.en: Rows running one way, columns running the other, separated by a thin insulating
cues.zh: 行朝一側延伸，列朝另一側延伸，由薄絕緣層隔開

cues.text: layer so they never actually meet.
cues.en: layer so they never actually meet.
cues.zh: 層，因此他們從未真正相遇。

cues.text: At every crossing point, the two lines sit close enough to influence each other
cues.en: At every crossing point, the two lines sit close enough to influence each other
cues.zh: 在每個交叉點，兩條線都足夠靠近以相互影響

cues.text: without contact.
cues.en: without contact.
cues.zh: 無需接觸。

cues.text: That is a capacitor — two conductors, near each other, not touching.
cues.en: That is a capacitor — two conductors, near each other, not touching.
cues.zh: 那是一個電容器——兩個導體，彼此靠近，但不接觸。

cues.text: A modern phone screen has thousands of these crossings.
cues.en: A modern phone screen has thousands of these crossings.
cues.zh: 現代手機螢幕上有數千個這樣的交叉點。

cues.text: The controller drives a voltage down the rows and measures what arrives on the
cues.en: The controller drives a voltage down the rows and measures what arrives on the
cues.zh: 控制器驅動各行的電壓並測量到達行的電壓

cues.text: columns.
cues.en: columns.
cues.zh: 列。

cues.text: Every crossing gets checked, over and over, dozens of times a second.
cues.en: Every crossing gets checked, over and over, dozens of times a second.
cues.zh: 每個交叉口都會被一遍又一遍地檢查，每秒數十次。

cues.text: Now look for the part that senses touch.
cues.en: Now look for the part that senses touch.
cues.zh: 現在尋找感知觸控的部分。

cues.text: There isn't one.
cues.en: There isn't one.
cues.zh: 沒有一個。

cues.text: There are wires, and there is a chip counting how strongly those wires talk to
cues.en: There are wires, and there is a chip counting how strongly those wires talk to
cues.zh: 有電線，有一個晶片可以計算這些電線的通話強度

cues.text: each other.
cues.en: each other.
cues.zh: 彼此。

cues.text: Here is what happens when your finger arrives.
cues.en: Here is what happens when your finger arrives.
cues.zh: 以下是當您的手指到達時會發生的情況。

cues.text: You are a conductor.
cues.en: You are a conductor.
cues.zh: 你是一名指揮。

cues.text: Not a good one, but a real one — a human body is mostly salt water,
cues.en: Not a good one, but a real one — a human body is mostly salt water,
cues.zh: 不是一個好的身體，而是一個真實的身體－人體主要是鹽水，

cues.text: and salt water carries charge.
cues.en: and salt water carries charge.
cues.zh: 鹽水帶有電荷。

cues.text: Bring a conductor close to that grid and it bleeds off some of the electric field
cues.en: Bring a conductor close to that grid and it bleeds off some of the electric field
cues.zh: 將導體靠近該網格，它會釋放一些電場

cues.text: that was running between the row and the column.
cues.en: that was running between the row and the column.
cues.zh: 它在行和列之間執行。

cues.text: The coupling between them weakens.
cues.en: The coupling between them weakens.
cues.zh: 它們之間的耦合減弱。

cues.text: The chip sees a number drop.
cues.en: The chip sees a number drop.
cues.zh: 晶片數量下降。

cues.text: That is the entire signal.
cues.en: That is the entire signal.
cues.zh: 這就是整個訊號。

cues.text: One number, at one crossing, slightly lower than it was a moment ago.
cues.en: One number, at one crossing, slightly lower than it was a moment ago.
cues.zh: 一個數字，在一個十字路口，比剛才稍低。

cues.text: The chip asks a single question at every crossing, thousands of times a second:
cues.en: The chip asks a single question at every crossing, thousands of times a second:
cues.zh: 晶片在每個交叉點都會詢問一個問題，每秒數千次：

cues.text: **has something conductive come near?** I call this the Conductor Test.
cues.en: **has something conductive come near?** I call this the Conductor Test.
cues.zh: **附近有導電的東西嗎？ ** 我稱之為導體測試。

cues.text: Wool fails it.
cues.en: Wool fails it.
cues.zh: 羊毛失敗了。

cues.text: Wool is an insulator — it is warm precisely because it does not carry things
cues.en: Wool is an insulator — it is warm precisely because it does not carry things
cues.zh: 羊毛是絕緣體——它之所以溫暖正是因為它不承載任何東西

cues.text: through itself.
cues.en: through itself.
cues.zh: 透過自身。

cues.text: Your finger is still there, still pressing, still a finger.
cues.en: Your finger is still there, still pressing, still a finger.
cues.zh: 你的手指還在那兒，仍然按著，仍然是一根手指。

cues.text: The screen reports, entirely accurately, that nothing conductive is nearby.
cues.en: The screen reports, entirely accurately, that nothing conductive is nearby.
cues.zh: 螢幕完全準確地報告附近沒有任何導電物體。

cues.text: The screen is not ignoring you.
cues.en: The screen is not ignoring you.
cues.zh: 螢幕並沒有忽略你。

cues.text: It is answering a question you did not ask.
cues.en: It is answering a question you did not ask.
cues.zh: 它正在回答一個你沒有問過的問題。

cues.text: Notice what else falls out of that.
cues.en: Notice what else falls out of that.
cues.zh: 注意其中還有什麼。

cues.text: The Conductor Test does not require contact.
cues.en: The Conductor Test does not require contact.
cues.zh: 導體測試不需要接觸。

cues.text: Hold your finger a millimetre above the glass and the field is already disturbed —
cues.en: Hold your finger a millimetre above the glass and the field is already disturbed —
cues.zh: 將手指放在玻璃上方一毫米處，場就已經受到幹擾 -

cues.text: on a sensitive panel, already detected.
cues.en: on a sensitive panel, already detected.
cues.zh: 在敏感面板上，已檢測到。

cues.text: Some screens use this deliberately and call it hover.
cues.en: Some screens use this deliberately and call it hover.
cues.zh: 有些螢幕故意使用此功能並將其稱為懸停。

cues.text: And pressure does nothing.
cues.en: And pressure does nothing.
cues.zh: 而壓力則無濟於事。

cues.text: Press as hard as you like.
cues.en: Press as hard as you like.
cues.zh: 隨心所欲地按壓。

cues.text: The field does not care how much force is behind the conductor, only how close it is
cues.en: The field does not care how much force is behind the conductor, only how close it is
cues.zh: 場不關心導體後面有多少力，只關心導體有多近

cues.text: and how much of it there is.
cues.en: and how much of it there is.
cues.zh: 以及有多少。

cues.text: A gentle tap and an angry jab produce the same reading.
cues.en: A gentle tap and an angry jab produce the same reading.
cues.zh: 輕輕的敲擊和憤怒的刺擊會產生相同的讀數。

cues.text: Which means the screen cannot tell a deliberate press from a brush.
cues.en: Which means the screen cannot tell a deliberate press from a brush.
cues.zh: 這意味著螢幕無法區分故意按壓和刷子。

cues.text: It never could.
cues.en: It never could.
cues.zh: 它永遠不可能。

cues.text: Everything you think of as the difference between tapping and grazing is a decision
cues.en: Everything you think of as the difference between tapping and grazing is a decision
cues.zh: 你所認為的割草和放牧之間的差異都是一個決定

cues.text: made in software, after the fact, from numbers that contain no force in them
cues.en: made in software, after the fact, from numbers that contain no force in them
cues.zh: 事後用軟體由不包含任何力量的數字製成

cues.text: at all.
cues.en: at all.
cues.zh: 根本不。

cues.text: Then there is the question of where you touched.
cues.en: Then there is the question of where you touched.
cues.zh: 然後就是你觸控的地方的問題。

cues.text: The grid is not fine.
cues.en: The grid is not fine.
cues.zh: 網格不太好。

cues.text: Typical spacing between electrodes runs between three and a half and five
cues.en: Typical spacing between electrodes runs between three and a half and five
cues.zh: 電極之間的典型間距在三點半到五點之間

cues.text: millimetres — call it four.
cues.en: millimetres — call it four.
cues.zh: 毫米——稱之為四。

cues.text: That is not a limitation anyone is apologising for.
cues.en: That is not a limitation anyone is apologising for.
cues.zh: 這並不是任何人都需要道歉的限制。

cues.text: It is chosen, deliberately, to be about the width of a fingertip's
cues.en: It is chosen, deliberately, to be about the width of a fingertip's
cues.zh: 它被故意選擇為大約指尖的寬度

cues.text: contact patch, so that a finger always covers two or three electrodes at once.
cues.en: contact patch, so that a finger always covers two or three electrodes at once.
cues.zh: 接觸貼片，以便手指始終同時覆蓋兩個或三個電極。

cues.text: Meanwhile the display underneath is drawing pixels about five hundredths of a
cues.en: Meanwhile the display underneath is drawing pixels about five hundredths of a
cues.zh: 同時，下面的顯示器正在繪製大約百分之五的畫素。

cues.text: millimetre apart.
cues.en: millimetre apart.
cues.zh: 相隔毫米。

cues.text: Put those two numbers beside each other.
cues.en: Put those two numbers beside each other.
cues.zh: 將這兩個數字放在一起。

cues.text: The sensor grid sees in steps of four millimetres.
cues.en: The sensor grid sees in steps of four millimetres.
cues.zh: 感測器網格以四毫米為單位進行觀察。

cues.text: The screen draws in steps of five hundredths.
cues.en: The screen draws in steps of five hundredths.
cues.zh: 螢幕以百分之五的步長繪製。

cues.text: **The screen can draw a line eighty times finer than the grid can see it.**
cues.en: **The screen can draw a line eighty times finer than the grid can see it.**
cues.zh: **螢幕可以畫出比網格能看到的線條細八十倍的線條。 **

cues.text: So the phone does not find your finger.
cues.en: So the phone does not find your finger.
cues.zh: 所以手機找不到你的手指。

cues.text: It reads how much the field sagged at each of the neighbouring electrodes,
cues.en: It reads how much the field sagged at each of the neighbouring electrodes,
cues.zh: 它讀取每個相鄰電極處的場下垂程度，

cues.text: weighs those readings against each other, and calculates a centre of mass.
cues.en: weighs those readings against each other, and calculates a centre of mass.
cues.zh: 將這些讀數相互權衡，並計算質心。

cues.text: The crisp point where the cursor lands is an average of a smear, computed from three
cues.en: The crisp point where the cursor lands is an average of a smear, computed from three
cues.zh: 遊標所在的清晰點是塗抹的平均值，由三個資料計算得出

cues.text: or four coarse numbers.
cues.en: or four coarse numbers.
cues.zh: 或四個粗略數字。

cues.text: I call this the Blob.
cues.en: I call this the Blob.
cues.zh: 我稱之為「Blob」。

cues.text: You have never put a point on a screen.
cues.en: You have never put a point on a screen.
cues.zh: 您從未在螢幕上放置過一個點。

cues.text: You have put a four-millimetre patch of damp conductor near a coarse grid,
cues.en: You have put a four-millimetre patch of damp conductor near a coarse grid,
cues.zh: 你在粗網格附近放置了一塊四毫米長的潮濕導體，

cues.text: and the phone has done arithmetic.
cues.en: and the phone has done arithmetic.
cues.zh: 而手機已經完成了算術。

cues.text: By now the obvious objection has arrived, and it is a good one.
cues.en: By now the obvious objection has arrived, and it is a good one.
cues.zh: 現在明顯的反對意見已經到來，而且是一個好的反對意見。

cues.text: This is all extraordinarily indirect.
cues.en: This is all extraordinarily indirect.
cues.zh: 這一切都是非常間接的。

cues.text: Why not simply detect the press?
cues.en: Why not simply detect the press?
cues.zh: 為什麼不簡單地檢測媒體呢？

cues.text: They did.
cues.en: They did.
cues.zh: 他們做到了。

cues.text: For about thirty years, that is exactly what touchscreens were.
cues.en: For about thirty years, that is exactly what touchscreens were.
cues.zh: 大約三十年來，觸控螢幕就是這樣。

cues.text: A resistive screen is two transparent conductive sheets held a fraction of a
cues.en: A resistive screen is two transparent conductive sheets held a fraction of a
cues.zh: 電阻屏是兩片透明導電片，固定一小部分

cues.text: millimetre apart by tiny invisible spacer dots.
cues.en: millimetre apart by tiny invisible spacer dots.
cues.zh: 毫米間隔由微小的看不見的間隔點。

cues.text: The top sheet is flexible.
cues.en: The top sheet is flexible.
cues.zh: 頂板是有彈性的。

cues.text: Press it and the two sheets touch.
cues.en: Press it and the two sheets touch.
cues.zh: 按下它，兩張紙就會接觸。

cues.text: The controller measures the resistance from the contact point to each edge,
cues.en: The controller measures the resistance from the contact point to each edge,
cues.zh: 控制器測量從接觸點到每個邊緣的電阻，

cues.text: and resistance tells it position.
cues.en: and resistance tells it position.
cues.zh: 阻力告訴它位置。

cues.text: Press harder and nothing changes — but the press itself is the event.
cues.en: Press harder and nothing changes — but the press itself is the event.
cues.zh: 再用力按壓，什麼也不會改變──但按壓本身就是事件。

cues.text: That is a real measurement of a real physical thing.
cues.en: That is a real measurement of a real physical thing.
cues.zh: 這是對真實物理事物的真實測量。

cues.text: Two objects met.
cues.en: Two objects met.
cues.zh: 兩個物體相遇了。

cues.text: There is no inference anywhere in it.
cues.en: There is no inference anywhere in it.
cues.zh: 其中沒有任何推論。

cues.text: And it worked with everything.
cues.en: And it worked with everything.
cues.zh: 它適用於一切。

cues.text: A gloved hand.
cues.en: A gloved hand.
cues.zh: 一隻戴著手套的手。

cues.text: A fingernail.
cues.en: A fingernail.
cues.zh: 一個指甲。

cues.text: A pen cap.
cues.en: A pen cap.
cues.zh: 筆帽。

cues.text: The blunt end of a fork.
cues.en: The blunt end of a fork.
cues.zh: 叉子的鈍端。

cues.text: Resistive screens do not care what you are made of, because they are not asking.
cues.en: Resistive screens do not care what you are made of, because they are not asking.
cues.zh: 電阻式螢幕並不在乎你是由什麼構成的，因為它們不會詢問。

cues.text: If you used a cash machine, a supermarket self-checkout,
cues.en: If you used a cash machine, a supermarket self-checkout,

cues.zh: 一些面板透過單獨的硬體新增力感應。

cues.text: Some run a second scanning mode to pick up hovering.
cues.en: Some run a second scanning mode to pick up hovering.
cues.zh: 有些執行第二種掃描模式來拾取懸停。

cues.text: The details vary by manufacturer and by year.
cues.en: The details vary by manufacturer and by year.
cues.zh: 詳細資訊因製造商和年份而異。

cues.text: What does not vary is the grid underneath, and what the grid measures.
cues.en: What does not vary is the grid underneath, and what the grid measures.
cues.zh: 不變的是下面的網格以及網格測量的內容。

cues.text: Put your finger on the screen.
cues.en: Put your finger on the screen.
cues.zh: 將手指放在螢幕上。

cues.text: Anywhere.
cues.en: Anywhere.
cues.zh: 任何地方。

cues.text: Something happened just now.
cues.en: Something happened just now.
cues.zh: 剛才發生了一些事。

cues.text: A few crossings under your fingertip lost a fraction of their coupling, three or four numbers dropped,
cues.en: A few crossings under your fingertip lost a fraction of their coupling, three or four numbers dropped,
cues.zh: 指尖下方的一些交叉點失去了一小部分耦合，丟失了三、四個數字，

cues.text: and a chip did the arithmetic.
cues.en: and a chip did the arithmetic.
cues.zh: 一個晶片完成了算術。

cues.text: Nothing there felt you.
cues.en: Nothing there felt you.
cues.zh: 那裡什麼也感覺不到你。

cues.text: There is no surface being pressed, no contact being registered, no sensation of any kind being collected.
cues.en: There is no surface being pressed, no contact being registered, no sensation of any kind being collected.
cues.zh: 沒有表面被按壓，沒有接觸被記錄，沒有任何型別的感覺被收集。

cues.text: There is a field, and the field went strange near one corner of a grid,
cues.en: There is a field, and the field went strange near one corner of a grid,
cues.zh: 有一個場，這個場在網格的一個角落附近變得很奇怪，

cues.text: and the phone made a confident guess about why.
cues.en: and the phone made a confident guess about why.
cues.zh: 手機對原因做出了自信的猜測。

cues.text: It has been guessing all day, and it has been right almost every time, which is why you have never noticed —
cues.en: It has been guessing all day, and it has been right almost every time, which is why you have never noticed —
cues.zh: 它整天都在猜測，而且幾乎每次都是對的，所以你從來沒有註意到——

cues.text: until the morning you put gloves on and discovered that the most responsive object
cues.en: until the morning you put gloves on and discovered that the most responsive object
cues.zh: 直到有一天早上，你戴上手套，發現反應最敏感的物體

cues.text: you own has no idea you exist.
cues.en: you own has no idea you exist.
cues.zh: 你自己不知道你的存在。

cues.text: You have never touched your phone.
cues.en: You have never touched your phone.
cues.zh: 你從來沒有碰過你的手機。

cues.text: You have only ever been noticed by it.
cues.en: You have only ever been noticed by it.
cues.zh: 你只是被它注意到了。
